Therefore ''Solo'', which this novel adapts, takes place in [[10 BBY]], and the prologue that takes place three years prior is set in [[13 BBY]]. |series= |preceded by= |followed by= }} '''''Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition''''' is the novelization of the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Anthology'']] film, ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. The novelization features extended and alternate content not featured in the film, such as a look at [[Han Solo]]'s career in the [[Imperial Navy]] and the events that led [[Qi'ra]] to [[Crimson Dawn]]. It was written by [[Mur Lafferty]] and first published by [[Del Rey]] on [[September 4]], 2018 in hardcover and eBook formats. A paperback edition was released on [[April 30]], [[2019]].
